decision: argmax of uncalibrated nine-class probabilities; deterministic first class on exact tie
guard: For each paired seed require Scratch TP >= A, normal-any FP <= A and normal-Scratch FP <= A. At least one strict improvement in Scratch TP or normal-any FP over the three seeds required for cost replay. Redirection of normal FPs to another defect alone is not improvement. Synthetic versus real-repeat separately tests substitution at equal sample budget.
student_selection: descriptive only; both tune subpartitions used to qualify RF77 pseudo-labels
cost_policy: RF71 s42 gate (>=0.5); fixed queue; rank by calibrated probability of any defect
